duties.duty: Section scope check: distribution functions, atoms, densities and mixed distributions are actually treated on the route (beyond the unit components).
duties.note: Atoms and law types (def), countable atom split with uniqueness, three-part decomposition with CDF form, mixture weights and integration formula, regimes corollary, identification procedure, two worked mixed laws and limits warning, all with written proofs. Attributions checked in held sources: Durrett pp. 13-14 (definitions, Example 1.2.9) and Feller II sec. V.2 pp. 137-138 (atoms, eqs. 2.4-2.5 'Jordan decomposition theorem') and sec. V.3 p. 142 (eq. 3.9 three-part mixture, no uniqueness clause).
